testing_and_testids.rule: ALL interactive components, navigation links, buttons, form inputs, tabs, dropdowns, and status indicators MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the deep navy (#0A1128) and champagne gold (#C5A059) aesthetic with light editorial content sections (#F9F8F6) for maximum McKinsey/BCG/Awwwards contrast.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion smooth scroll behavior for premium momentum.
Use Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display Google Fonts for headlines and Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans for body text.
Ensure all interactive flows (Jurisdiction Matrix, Holding Structure Visualizer, Smart Multi-Step Consultation Form, and Admin Enquiries View) are fully functional with state handling.
Ensure explicit data-testid attributes on every button, link, tab, input, and interactive element as per testing standards.
Use Sonner for polished notification toasts upon form submission or inquiry bookings.
Avoid generic centered layouts, low-contrast text, or plain Inter fonts for headings.
